Vision & Roadmap

The Vision

Where Sustainabox is going, how we'll get there, and what success looks like.

What We're Building

SustainaBox is the trusted advisor and platform for entrepreneurs and enterprises building resilient, sustainable housing and alternative facilities. We combine enterprise-grade risk thinking with hands-on construction expertise to help you design, plan, and execute projects that survive chaos and scale impact.

Three-Year Vision

Year 1: Foundation (2025)

Goal: $50K–80K revenue. Establish authority, land first clients, build product suite.

  • Launch consulting practice (target: 2–3 clients)
  • Build digital product suite (cost calculator, planner, checklists)
  • Launch first cohort-based course
  • Build content engine (YouTube, Substack, blog)
  • Establish thought leadership positioning

Year 2: Scale (2026)

Goal: $200K–400K revenue. Prove repeatability, scale courses and workshops.

  • 2–3 course cohorts (20–30 students each)
  • Host quarterly workshops at property (4–6 per year)
  • Build membership community to 200+ members
  • Expand consulting to 4–5 clients annually
  • Explore licensing opportunities (prefab design, IP)
  • YouTube reaches 10K–50K subscribers

Year 3: Maturity (2027)

Goal: $500K–1.2M revenue. Diversified, passive income streams, ready to scale further.

  • 4–6 course cohorts annually (80K–150K/year)
  • 6–8 annual workshops (120K–250K/year)
  • 500+ community members (150K–200K/year recurring)
  • Licensing deals generating passive revenue (50K–200K/year)
  • Content monetization (50K–150K/year)
  • Selective high-ticket consulting (50K–100K/year)

The Business Model Portfolio

We're not betting everything on one revenue stream. Instead, we're building complementary offerings that reinforce each other:

Consulting

Revenue: $30K–150K/year

Role: Lead income generator. Fast to market. Builds case studies and credibility.

Course (Cohort-Based)

Revenue: $20K–150K/year

Role: Scales beyond 1:1 consulting. Higher volume, lower per-student price.

Products (Digital)

Revenue: $5K–20K/year

Role: Passive income. Lead magnet for email list. Low cost to maintain.

Membership

Revenue: $30K–200K/year

Role: Recurring revenue. Ecosystem play. Ties everything together.

Workshops (Property)

Revenue: $80K–250K/year

Role: Combines learning + hospitality. Uses physical asset. Premium pricing.

IP & Licensing

Revenue: $50K–200K/year

Role: Passive income at scale. Prefab design, frameworks, methodology.

Why This Works

✓ Authentic Proof Point

We built what we teach. The property is real. Lessons are documented. This is hard to fake and builds immediate credibility.

✓ Complementary Revenue Streams

Consulting funds Year 1 and builds case studies. Course scales without sacrificing 1:1 time. Products are passive. Community is recurring. No single revenue stream carries the whole business.

✓ Founder Advantage

15+ years in enterprise resilience + hands-on container home build. Few people have this combination. It's defensible and differentiated.

✓ Scalable Without Sacrificing Quality

Consulting stays 1:1 but course, products, and community allow leverage. We can serve more people without burning out.

✓ Multiple Paths to $100K

We don't need all revenue streams to hit. Hit consulting (3–4 clients) + course (1–2 cohorts) and we're at $100K+.

The Case Study

Your property isn't just a project—it's an asset that produces multiple revenue streams:

  • ✓ Consulting case study (proof of concept)
  • ✓ Course example (real photos, real problems, real solutions)
  • ✓ Workshop venue (learn on-property)
  • ✓ Hospitality (Airbnb, retreat model)
  • ✓ Media backdrop (YouTube, content creation)
